decisions.reason: The 518 FLEX trommel builds on the established BASIC 518 and sits in the firm's core mobile screening business, so its results likely meet the aspiration even after a difficult period.
The flail shredder line fits the core mobile-processing portfolio, and nothing points to a shortfall large enough to trigger problemistic search, although tighter slack makes it less secure.
With little slack and uncertain results, a stationary fine shredder that had little visibility is a peripheral item whose resources are better put back into the core mobile business.
Green waste and composting are core customer segments, so the firm keeps this grinder line, but its low visibility leaves it exposed to portfolio pruning.
The single-shaft pre-shredder line serves the stationary plant business the firm wants to grow and had its own page, so it is retained, though stationary lines face more scrutiny when slack is low.
